passage_text: Researchers conducted a randomized controlled trial to evaluate the efficacy of a novel antihypertensive agent, Hypertenso, in reducing systolic blood pressure among adults with stage 1 hypertension. Two hundred and forty participants were enrolled and randomly assigned to either the Hypertenso group (n=120) or a placebo group (n=120). Baseline mean systolic blood pressure (SBP) was 145.2 mmHg (SD 10.5) in the Hypertenso group and 144.8 mmHg (SD 10.3) in the placebo group. After a 4‑week treatment period, the Hypertenso group’s mean SBP decreased to 130.4 mmHg (SD 9.8), while the placebo group’s mean SBP fell to 141.6 mmHg (SD 10.1). The mean change in SBP was −14.8 mmHg (SD 3.2) for Hypertenso and −3.2 mmHg (SD 3.5) for placebo. The study also recorded adverse events, with 5% of participants in the Hypertenso group reporting dizziness compared to 2% in placebo. These findings suggest Hypertenso produces a clinically meaningful reduction in systolic blood pressure over a short period, with a tolerable safety profile.
table_data:
Group | N | Baseline SBP (mmHg) | 4‑Week SBP (mmHg) | Mean Change (mmHg) | 4‑Week SBP SD
--- | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---
Hypertenso | 120 | 145.2 | 130.4 | -14.8 | 9.8
Placebo | 120 | 144.8 | 141.6 | -3.2 | 10.1
stem: Which group experienced a greater average reduction in systolic blood pressure after 4 weeks?

options.C: Both groups had the same reduction

explanation: The mean change in systolic blood pressure was −14.8 mmHg for the Hypertenso group and −3.2 mmHg for placebo, indicating a greater reduction in the Hypertenso group.
trap: Students pick the placebo group by overlooking the sign, but placebo SBP fell only 3.2 mmHg versus 14.8 mmHg with Hypertenso.

stem: What best describes the study design used in this trial?
explanation: Participants were randomly assigned to Hypertenso or placebo, which is the hallmark of a randomized controlled trial.
trap: Students may pick an observational cohort design because participants were followed over time, but random assignment to Hypertenso or placebo defines an RCT.

stem: Which of the following statements is most accurate regarding the safety profile of Hypertenso?

options.A: 5% reported dizziness, which is higher than placebo
options.B: 5% reported dizziness, which is lower than placebo

explanation: The study reported dizziness in 5% of the Hypertenso group versus 2% in placebo, indicating a higher incidence in the treatment group.
trap: Students reverse the comparison, reading 5% versus 2% as lower for Hypertenso, when the treatment group had the higher dizziness rate.
